decisions.reason: The mitred handle family stayed on the website in both years. In a design-led hardware firm a handle family carries low holding costs, so with no shortfall signalled against aspirations there is no trigger for problemistic search.
The multifunctional handle moved from a mention to a page of its own in 2024. That suggests results meeting aspirations and growing management commitment, so keeping it is the satisficing choice.

The handle is still listed but has gained no extra emphasis, which points to modest but adequate results. Available slack lets the firm carry it rather than divert resources while the outcome remains uncertain.

The FSB 1289 collection won the German Design Award and the iF Design Award and has its own page in both years. These are clear signals of performance above aspirations relative to comparable firms, so dropping it would be irrational.
